name: Cozad New Venture Challenge 2027
organizer: Nichole Kelly Landuyt Center for Entrepreneurship, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
description: The Cozad New Venture Challenge is the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign campuswide venture creation competition, run by the Nichole Kelly Landuyt Center for Entrepreneurship, with a dedicated Health Care Track fed by teams from the Carle Illinois Health Make-a-Thon. The 2027 cycle had not been scheduled as of September 2026; registration was expected to open in fall 2026 following the pattern of prior cycles.

deadlines.label: Registration deadline
deadlines.note: Estimated by repeating the 2026 cycle date (Feb 1, 2026); the 2027 schedule was not yet published as of September 2026.

deadlines.label: Finals and Demo Day
deadlines.note: Estimated by repeating the 2026 cycle dates (Demo Day April 16, finals April 17, 2026); the 2027 schedule was not yet published.

sources.note: 2026 cycle schedule: registration deadline Feb 1 2026, kickoff Feb 4, workshops through March, Demo Day Showcase April 16, finals April 17
Confirms registration for the 2027 cycle was expected to open in fall 2026; program described as in its 26th year
Confirms the Cozad Health Care Track follows the Fall Health Make-a-Thon for CI MED student teams

notes: 2027 Cozad dates are not yet published; the deadlines above are estimated from the confirmed 2026 cycle. Cozad itself is a campuswide, multi-track venture competition, not health specific, but is included because of its Health Care Track.
